what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to set a single uniform tax rate across all property classes for FY2021.
The board unanimously accepted the tripartite agreement for 250 Howard Street and waived the town's right of first refusal on the property.
The board left first refusal on 360 Flat Hill Road open until the open space committee reports, not to exceed the January time frame.
The board reviewed the BrightFarms TIF draft, where the base valuation changed because the company is buying only part of the parcel. No vote was taken.
The board unanimously ratified the town manager's appointment of a new DPW director, along with an alternate building inspector.

why_it_matters: A single tax rate means homes and businesses are taxed at the same rate per thousand dollars of value, rather than shifting more of the levy onto commercial and industrial property.

The 360 Flat Hill Road decision keeps the town's option to buy the land open while the open space committee reports, and the BrightFarms TIF would set the tax break the company receives on its property.
watch_next: The open space committee's report on 360 Flat Hill Road, due before the January time frame ends.
A joint meeting of the Select Board and the Parks Commission on December 1.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the main votes (tax classification, 250 Howard Street, DPW director, conservation disclosure) and on most shared figures. The main difference is that our minutes record an alternate building inspector ratification, the 360 Flat Hill Road decision and a Parks Commission joint meeting that the official minutes do not contain, so a person should check those against the video.
